Application Data.NAME: Gemstone Haven Jewelers
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Gemstone Lane, Suite 100, Jewel City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Gemstone Haven Jewelers specializes in the retail sale of fine jewelry and watches, offering a curated selection of both contemporary and vintage pieces. Our operations include sourcing high-quality gemstones, custom design services, and professional repairs conducted by skilled jewelers. We prioritize security with a fully alarmed and monitored premises that includes 24/7 video surveillance. Our inventory is meticulously documented with regular appraisals to ensure accurate valuation. We do not offer on-site rentals or conduct classes, focusing solely on retail sales to maintain a safe and secure environment for our customers and staff.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, we experienced a theft incident where a customer distractively enabled a theft by concealing two high-value watches during a testing process. The total loss amount was estimated at $5,000. The claim has been reported to the police and our insurance carrier, and is currently pending investigation. All security measures were functioning, including our alarm system and video surveillance.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: UL Class 1, Grade A, Commercial Security Safe, 1,200 lbs, 90-minute fire rating, monitored alarm system
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: 24/7 monitored security system with on-site security personnel and a high-quality commercial safe.
